bibl.note: One-based viewer images 192–192; printed page numbers are 44 lower. Archive page labels differ from both. The actual images, rather than another witness or uncorrected OCR, supply the readings.

normalization.p: Source spelling, capitalization, punctuation, written ampersands and visible accents are retained. Long s and typographic ligatures are represented by standard s and constituent letters. Letter spacing in display capitals and quotation glyph shapes may be represented schematically. No modern-edition readings are substituted.

segmentation.p: Each l represents one canonical verse, with stable numbering and a link to its existing image region. Source verse order and headings are retained. Couplet grouping and canonical line numbers are editorial. A displaced word may remain within its verse with its position marked.

Both readers checked actual full-page line starts. The regular visible insets are retained, with an additional two-character approximation at verse 2 for the enlarged initial’s exceptional opening inset. This is source layout evidence, not a rule inferred from verse parity.

correction.p: Uncertain readings remain locally marked with unclear or gap. Observations and uncertainties are documented for a different source reader; ink colour alone does not establish erasure or a separate hand.

revisionDesc.change: First reader inspected and transcribed all 20 verses from the source images; independent source review pending.

Independent second source pass checked every extant verse, source heading, page furniture and full-page line starts; corrected supported readings and documented the source layout in W-3.15-second-pass.md.

Focused independent image reinspection of the enlarged opening initial and following letters corrected source capitalization Quaere to QUaere; remaining opening letters and second-verse layout rechecked before resealing.

Fresh corpus source reading rechecked all 20 verses, every evidence note, headings, page furniture and full-page line starts. No further verse wording changes were supported. Prior independent second-pass history is retained; changed readings were additionally corroborated from native crops by /root/w_review_c. See W-3.15-second-pass.md.

lg.label: Elegia XV. Ad Venerem, quod elegis finem imponat.
lg.l: QUaere novum vatem, tenerorum mater Amorum:
Raditur hic Elegis ultima meta meis.
Quos ego composui, Peligni ruris alumnus:
Nec me deliciae dedecuere meae.
Si quid id est, usque à proavis vetus ordinis heres,
Non modo militiae turbine factus eques.
Mantua Virgilio gaudet, Verona Catullo:
Pelignae dicar gloria gentis ego.
Quam sua libertas ad honesta coëgerat arma,
Cum timuit socias anxia Roma manus.
Atque aliquis spectans hospes Sulmonis aquosi
Moenia, quâ campi jugera pauca tenent?
Quae tantum, dicet, potuistis ferre Poëtam,
Quantulacumque estis, vos ego magna voco.
Culte puer, puerique parens Amathusia culti,
Aurea de campo vellite signa meo.
Corniger increpuit thyrso graviore Lyaeus:
Pulsanda est magnis area major equis.
Imbelles Elegi, genialis Musa, valete;
Post mea mansurum fata superstes opus.
